name: beads-storage
title: Beads is the storage layer for CoBuilder programs, epics, and slices
outcome: CoBuilder workflow state for programs, epics, and slices is stored in beads, read back through the same data/index.json, and answered by bd ready instead of by a human rereading a markdown table.
done_when: a seeded tracker holds every program, epic, slice, and decision of this repository with its metadata envelope, and the counts match the current index: 16 designs, 77 epics, 47 slices, 30 ADRs
shared/build_index.py produces a byte-comparable data/index.json from the beads read plus the unchanged file sources, and the viewer needs no change
the slice ladder answers what is next with bd ready, closing slice n-1 makes slice n appear, and a gate blocks its epic until resolve
every script that writes state calls bd and degrades to the file flow when bd is absent
abort_if: the metadata envelope cannot round-trip through bd create, bd update, bd export, and bd list --json without loss
the index rebuild depends on network state or on GitHub credentials, because beads is the only new source and it is local
the mapping needs a second custom type beyond program, which would mean the built-in vocabulary was misread

min_work.note: The mapping was smoke-tested against bd 1.3.0 in a scratch tracker before drafting: parent-child creation, blocked-by ladder chaining, the readiness flip after close, gate creation with --blocks, and envelope round-trip through export and list --json all passed. Divergent exploration compared four storage options and kept beads with one custom type. Two risks surfaced and were accepted: the bd binary dependency with a file-flow fallback, and the missing metadata query language with the index staying the query surface.

epics.title: Seed the tracker: shared/beads_seed.py seeds programs, epics, slices, and decisions idempotently by external_ref
Read model: build_index.py projects entities and joins from bd list --json beside the file sources
Write model: implement and architect scripts flip slice and epic state through bd, with evidence files and gates
